# Carrow & John Ashdown

- [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) — Friend of — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) — spending evenings debating together by the fire · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Mary discusses her fear of damnation and beatings with [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) and [Grace](../character/grace.md) before being introduced to the [Carrows](../codex/factions.md#carrows) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Afterwards, the girls arrange for Mary to sleep in the parsonage garret room. Later that night, [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) comforts Mary in the garret, where Mary expresses her fears and jealousy before they reconcile and fall asleep.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS

> During a church service, [Grace](../character/grace.md) interrupts the collection to publicly defend her father and clarify the misunderstanding behind their Sunday cleaning. The next day, she and Edmund ride pigs down Main Street, drawing mixed reactions from townspeople and the local doctor's family. Later, Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to complain about Grace's antics, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends the child's brave intentions.
>

> Mrs. [Twiss](../character/twiss.md) leaves the manse after scolding the children and Mr. Ashdown. Disturbed by her accusations about his parenting, Mr. Ashdown reflects on his children's needs and decides to seek company and comfort by visiting [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md).

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) walks through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) on his way to propose to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), reflecting on his feelings for her and his reluctance to take a "suitable" second wife. Meanwhile, [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) prepares to hold [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to a past vow to reject him despite their fond mutual regard, leaving [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) anxious about turning him down.
